scope: Separate fourth-level design only. Preserve all top-difficulty originals and existing levels/models/themes. No runtime implementation dispatched.

geometryPieces.notCatalogRampCount: return grade, not an inertia-climb obstacle

lengthAccounting: Count each graph geometry edge once. Cross selector geometric skeleton16.72m differs from moving-arm reference ride; internal A cross geometric skeleton16m differs from quarter-turn ride. Seesaw uses material7m+low-tip gaps, not load-dependent world trajectory. Never sum A+B+C as a single run.

branchStateDesign.selection: uncommitted while on cross; commit when crossing A/B/C outward shore gate and activating its entry CP
branchStateDesign.reselect: before shore commitment freely move/change arms; after commitment restart current run to choose again, no invisible wall
branchStateDesign.requiredRoute: only selectedBranch ordered group gates; unchosen branches exempt
branchStateDesign.mergeCpActivation: selected branch complete AND cross common merge commit plane northbound
branchStateDesign.afterMergeFall: respawn CP-MERGED, preserve selectedBranch completion; do not require other two branches
branchStateDesign.finish: two opening units,selector exit,selectedBranch required gates andT01/T02 complete, then finish trigger
branchStateDesign.unsupportedNow: Current linear checkpoint array/progress cannot express conditional branch chain; graph-aware progress/checkpoints/route-tagged records are future work only

antiShortcutDesign: Branches only share selector and defined merge. No fixed cross-branch links.
A occupies west corridor; B doglegs remain east of A return corridor; C maintains east corridor and mirrors piston housing outward.
B final thin curved beam detours west and then passes north of its own two hairpins, avoiding self-overlap.
C return descent reaches3.4m before merge; high speed section does not land on B. No bridge across water between branches.
Wrong-branch landing or reverse merge traversal cannot satisfy ordered gates for selected branch, but no physics teleport or invisible wall is introduced.
Geometry alone cannot exclude every collision-launched flight; no physical playtest has been performed.
futureDependencies: physical four-port cross layout and per-route entry markers
conditional graph checkpoint/progress and merge/finish state
legacy hammer/cross/lift/platform repeated instances and yaw/phase
C reverse-traversed pusher orientation and real rod collision
route-tagged medals/records if chosen later, no thresholds now

validation.note: design arithmetic and local drawing only; no implementation or certification

implementationDecision: intended as fourth level; design only, not registered or implemented
timeConvention: All phase values reference global gameplay clock. A first chain and C middle chain repeat24s, A last chain12s; B load-driven arrivals have no fixed epoch. Boundary pads allow choosing launch time, no auto reset on entering group.

comparison.routeTimeClaim: No calibrated difficulty/time equality. C may reward good speed control; no wide bypass or all-three traversal requirement.
